events.title: MTV Launched
events.blurb: Music Television, MTV, launched on this day in 1981, famously kicking off with The Buggles' "Video Killed The Radio Star."

angles.name: MTV Launch Angle
angles.copy: Remember when music videos changed everything? We're taking a nostalgic trip back to the very first song ever played on MTV.

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, the legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair began in Bethel, New York, drawing hundreds of thousands for "3 Days of Peace & Music."

angles.name: Woodstock Angle
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since Woodstock, still no muddy fields for us! Just the very best of the iconic music that defined a generation.

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: We remember the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away on this day in 1977.

angles.name: Elvis Tribute
angles.copy: Forty-nine years today, we lost a legend. The music of Elvis Presley lives on, forever changing the sound of popular culture.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Happy 75th birthday to the iconic frontwoman of The Pretenders, Chrissie Hynde, born on this day in 1951.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday Angle
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Happy 54th birthday to the unmistakable voice of Oasis and solo artist, Liam Gallagher, born on this day in 1972.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday Angle
angles.copy: Our Kid is another year older! Celebrating Liam Gallagher's 54th with some absolute anthems.

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks Global James Bond Day, celebrating the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day Angle
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred! It's Global James Bond Day, so expect some legendary 007 theme tunes coming your way.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today, born in 1940.

angles.name: John Lennon Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we pay tribute to the incomparable John Lennon. His music and message live on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the comedy icon and Monty Python legend, John Cleese, born on this day in 1939.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday Angle
angles.copy: And now for something completely different... Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! What's your favourite Monty Python sketch?
